bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
r=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
w="$r/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015"
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = cd5255bb9f7fd4f6f8eb2db119e7bfcf2c413863
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
stage=ai-core-model-gate:uds-stale-guard-cd5255
backup=ai-core-model-gate:rollback-before-stale-cd5255
docker image inspect "$stage" >/dev/null
for n in ai-coder ai-qwen3 ai-granite ai-ministral; do test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = false; done
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]};f=lambda p:json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184"+p,headers=h),timeout=8));a=f("/internal/handoff/status");b=f("/internal/resources/status");assert not a["resident"] and not any(a["active"].values()) and not a["handoff"] and not a["recovery_pending"] and not b["queued"]'
docker image tag "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' ai-core-model-gate)" "$backup"
export AI_CORE_API_KEY="$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'printf %s "$AI_CORE_API_KEY"')"
test "${#AI_CORE_API_KEY}" -ge 16
docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$w/compose.gate.yml" --project-directory "$r" --env-file "$r/.env" config -q
rollback() { code=$?; trap - ERR; set +e; docker image tag "$backup" ai-core-model-gate:local; docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$w/compose.gate.yml" --project-directory "$r" --env-file "$r/.env" up -d --no-build --force-recreate gate; echo "STALE_GUARD_ROLLBACK_REQUESTED original_exit=$code"; exit "$code"; }
trap rollback ERR
docker image tag "$stage" ai-core-model-gate:local
docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$w/compose.gate.yml" --project-directory "$r" --env-file "$r/.env" up -d --no-build --force-recreate gate >/dev/null
expected=$(sha256sum "$w/runtime/model_gate.py" | cut -d' ' -f1)
actual=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sha256sum /app/runtime/model_gate.py | cut -d' ' -f1)
test "$expected" = "$actual"
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import urllib.request;[urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%d/health"%p,timeout=8).close() for p in (18181,18182,18183,18184)]'
trap - ERR
printf 'AI_CORE_UDS_STALE_GUARD_LIVE=PASS SOURCE_SHA256=%s BACKUP=%s\n' "$actual" "$backup"
